text:
priya: Starting safectl switchover for model v2b in the catalog. Change window 2026-04-02 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 50% -> 100% traffic in 15m steps. Fallback ordering: v2b-quant -> v2b-8bit -> v1-legacy. Need sign-offs on canary metrics (p99 gen latency <= 220ms, error rate < 0.5%), and final pin/rollback thresholds. @sam @alex

sam: Ack. I'll watch canary dashboards and alerts. Do we have the deploy-bot job id and preflight checklist?

deploy-bot: safectl-switchover-2425689999 queued by priya. Estimated start: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. Use `/abort safectl-switchover-2425689999` to stop. Logs: https://deploy.corp/jobs/2425689999

alex: Quick safety rules: if request error rate > 0.8% in any rolling 5m window -> auto rollback to v2b-8bit. If still failing after two minutes -> fallback to v1-legacy and notify oncall. Confirm these thresholds are set in Cerberus.

lee: I'll pin the fallback priority in the catalog config now. Current priority: [v2b-quant, v2b-8bit, v1-legacy]. Emergency pin command if needed:
```
rcli catalog pin --model v2b --version v1-legacy --reason "emergency-rollback"
```

maria: Canary datasets uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/safectl/v2b/canary-sets. Running evals at 5% and 50% and will post the table (latency, rouge/qa-f1, hallucination-rate).

priya: Good. Reminder: client SDK timeout guard is 10s, streaming allowed. Gate criteria: p99 gen latency, error rate, and hallucination regression delta <= 2%. @lee please add a runbook step for manual cutover to 100% after a green 50% window.

lee: Done — runbook updated. Manual cutover step includes checklist and a one-click abort link. Page @oncall-eng on escalation.

devops-bot: Change window advisory posted to #announcements (TTL 24h). Policy note: no infra changes during this window, only model switchover tasks allowed.

sam: I'll be monitoring dashboards. Quick question: if we see capacity pressure in eu-west, do we want regional fallback (keep other regions on v2b) or force global pin? I propose regional fallback first.

alex: Regional fallback first. Also add a capacity guard: abort switchover if available GPU capacity < 40% of expected footprint in any impacted region.

priya: Agreement. I'll run preflight smoke at 01:20 UTC: `/run smoke --model v2b --env staging`. Final go/no-go posted at 01:45 UTC.

deploy-bot: JOB UPDATE safectl-switchover-2425689999 STATUS: scheduled -> awaiting-start. To abort: `/abort safectl-switchover-2425689999`.

maria: Will paste canary metrics here after 02:10 and call green/red.

priya: Thanks everyone — will post the 01:45 status. :thumbsup:
